components.label: Backward-induction equilibrium of the platform-led sequential game
components.explanation: The model's equilibrium concept is Backward-induction equilibrium of the platform-led sequential game. Customers buy iff v≥p; agents choose x=w_b(1-p)/(2g); providers participate when their service payoff exceeds private reservation earning κ; the platform chooses p, w_o, and w_b anticipating these responses. Lemma 1 characterizes the optimal decisions by aggregation-cost regime.
